mechanism: Voriconazole is hepatotoxic and can elevate liver enzymes; pyrazinamide is also hepatotoxic, increasing risk of additive hepatotoxicity and potential treatment failure due to reduced voriconazole metabolism.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST/ALT/bilirubin) closely during concurrent use; consider alternative antifungal if possible, and assess clinical benefit versus hepatotoxicity risk.
